diagnosis: Fetch test with 256 NOPs (OP-IMM opcode 7'b0010011, e.g. addi x0,x0,0) asserts TRAP and reports FAIL 0xdead with no progress. Current line 877 decodes is_alu_reg_imm as 7'b0010010 instead of 7'b0010011, so OP-IMM is never recognized and with the corrected instr_trap logic every NOP traps. Root cause is the one-bit opcode typo in the mem_do_rinst decoder.
